finding.headline: "The Owambe-Anxiety Mum"
finding.problem: "In our culture a crying baby at the family party is 'your fault.' I already dread the aunties' side-eyes before I've even left the house."
finding.person: New mum invited to a naming ceremony / birthday / church harvest with her 3-month baby; terrified the baby will scream, she'll be banished to the back, and lose face in her close-knit community.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone (cultural angle) — "Show Up With Baby: Owambe & Family Events Without the Shame."". Verdict: PASSES.
